title: Details links and failing-step descriptions on commit statuses
description: Commit statuses carry no target_url, so GitHub's Details link leads nowhere, and a failure reads only 'Failed'. Add a detailsUrl option (with a tektonDashboardUrl helper) that sets target_url: TaskRun for a task's own status, PipelineRun for pending and reconciled ones. Name the first failing step and its exit code in the failure description.

title: Checks API reporter that puts failure logs in GitHub
description: Commit statuses hold only state, a 140-char description and a link, so seeing why a task failed needs a reachable console. A GitHubChecksReporter would post a check run per task instead (the PAC token is a GitHub App installation token, so the Checks API is open to it), with a Markdown summary, the tail of the failing step's output and annotations. Needs a core change first: a report step cannot read another step's output, so core's script wrapper would have to tee step output to a file under /tekton/home (bounded in size) for the reporter to read. Exported through core's public surface, per this repo's compatibility rule.

title: Run core conformance kit in tests; advisory CI job against @tektonic-ci/core@next
description: Parent: tektonic-uru.13 (tektonic-ci/core). Bump devDep core to ^2.2.0, add assertStatusReporterConformance tests (strict + report-only), add advisory test-core-next self-CI task.
